faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This listing fits the X1 Carbon 3rd Gen (2015, Type 20BS/20BT) only — it does not fit the 2nd Gen (2014) or earlier. Send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp if you're unsure.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this keyboard has a 2-level backlight, matching the original.
